findings.issue: The cellular classification argument is sound in form, but equality of its obstruction with the existing Chern class is asserted from normalization alone. The BPST calculation calibrates the generator on S4; the general relative-cell/Thom identification is not yet written. This is necessary to transfer the constructed connection to the actual specified bundle.
findings.smallest_repair: Identify the SU2 frame bundle with the unit S3-bundle of the associated complex rank2 bundle. On every four-cell the boundary unit-section degree is the relative zero-section Thom pullback (equivalently its signed local zero index). The resulting obstruction cocycle represents Euler(E_R), and the actual top-Chern/Euler theorem identifies it with c2(E), up to the fixed orientation convention. Explain the cellular coboundary adjustment for the difference class, then the existing extension/isomorphism/smoothing argument applies. No new helper queue is needed.

actual_checks: Scalar de Rham heat block and differentiated parametrix give the stated Green upper bound and actual inverse; maximum principle gives positive scalar kernel and constants give unit integral.
Kato Green absorption with fixed-radius split and the spectral gap yields the uniform L-infinity inverse bound, including zero forcing.

Weighted squared-gradient estimate follows from the exact product identity; covariant divergence interpolation gives gradientL4 squared ≤C sup|xi| HessianL2. Hessian commutations produce only F∇xi∇xi and F xi Hessian after integrating the derivative of F once, so only curvatureL2 and no derivative-of-curvature estimate is used.

The B completion embeds into L2, with weighted norm identity by subsequence/Fatou. The uniform bilinear bound extends actual smooth wedge products and the fixed point; each fixed smooth background gives xiH2 and aH1 on the same bundle.

The accepted curved weak proof admits the actual bounded forcing T_Axi: its localized forcing is L2∩L3 for the simultaneous gain, then L6. The augmented adjoint Clifford operator acting on (0,xi) gives xiW1,6, followed by coupled Wm,6 bootstrap.
The normal-metric BPST error is bounded by C lambda²/(lambda²+r²); the three-region Green estimate is uniform in the Green pole and has the claimed lambda² log size.

The spectral-gap contradiction has uniform L4 xi, hence no L2 point mass; local ordinary H1 bounds pass to a global finite-energy limit and the cutoff-annulus L4 product vanishes. The resulting anti-self-dual harmonic ordinary form contradicts bminus0.

Rescaled corrections have scale-invariant small L4 norm. Unit parallel adjoint sections converge to an actual BPST-parallel section; the three spanning curvature values exclude it. No classification of all charge1 instantons is used.
